owner_ruling: if a new optimizer cannot at least recover the benchmark quality on the same pool and projections, it fails the build

benchmark.scored_by: the same function that scores the optimizer, with no advantage given
benchmark.downward_bias_note: where the benchmark rosters a player with no FantasyCruncher row, those points are absent from its total. The benchmark is therefore understated and still wins.

checks.why: the optimizer must find a lineup at least as good as one that provably exists in the benchmark, on the same pool
unconstrained, the optimizer must match the benchmark portfolio mean. A diversified mode may legitimately score lower and is NOT measured here

verdict: SEARCH_NOT_TRUSTWORTHY: 2 of 2 floors unmet. No search change may be called an improvement without moving these numbers.
DELIBERATELY_RED_TODAY: this gate is expected to fail until the optimizer improves. A gate that passed on the day it was written would not be measuring anything.
